C9000114.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 114 (Approximate counting of common integer polymatroid bases.; papers: An FPRAS for Common Integer Polymatroid Bases with Binary Capacities; Approximate counting of common bases of two matroids; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/114.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ROOT_COUNTS.statement: For arbitrary integral normalized submodular f1,f2, ordinary integer-base difference counts on every root line have interval positive support and global log-concavity, including nonmonotone ranks and empty support.

L_ROOT_GROUPED.statement: Translated grouped rank penalties supply both quadratic signatures, including repeated physical groups, dual removals, invalid diagonals and reflection.

L_ROOT_ENCODING.statement: The finite balanced encoding has zero-penalty limit equal to ordinary unweighted integer-base pair counts, without labelled-copy multiplicities, for every integral translation and total.

L_ROOT_INTERPOLATION.statement: Every positive adjacent-log-concave finite sequence satisfies global interpolation; finite pointwise limits preserve it and consequently have interval support.

C_BALANCED.statement: Full arbitrary-capacity balanced-summation closure for arbitrary strictly positive full-slice weights, with removal, addition, and fixing.

L_BALANCED_CHAIN.statement: Universal quadratic-chain closure, including the null-axis capacity-one case and the capacity-two middle test.

L_BALANCED_BOX.statement: Full-slice positivity and zero extension supply exactly the chain hypotheses, without stronger signature assumptions.

L_BALANCED_REFLECTION.statement: Box reflection interchanges addition and removal and commutes with the balanced sum.

L_BALANCED_SPECTRAL.statement: For every finite real symmetric matrix, the working bilinear signature is equivalent to at most one positive eigenvalue counted with multiplicity.
